_comment: The carcass of a company terminal: sheet steel, the board, the screen glass. Four
draws, no filler, so a teardown always hands something back.
NO COMPONENT IN THIS POOL, deliberately. A pool that yields a Bulb would make this the
second object that yields one, and the one that yields a component is meant to be the
one that teaches it (ComponentBlueprintTests). What this find teaches is the two
terminals, declared at the top level so the fragment is granted without the pool having
to draw the thing it teaches.
